integrity: Infinite-dimensional proof included; finite checker is supplementary, not proof of the asymptotic.
scientific_limitations: Nonconstant finite Dirichlet polynomials; Hilbert exponent 2; measure supported arbitrarily close to zero. No assertion for infinite symbols, general p, or second-order singular-value terms. Historical priority comparisons incomplete by nature.
title: Sharp logarithmic singular-value law for polynomial Volterra operators on Bergman–Dirichlet spaces
